news.title: Lionel Messi scores 20th World Cup goal, extends streak to 8 games and takes Golden Boot lead
news.summary: Messi's goal in the 29th minute was the 20th of his World Cup career, extending his record and moving him two ahead of France's Kylian Mbappé on the all-time list.
